    @pytest.mark.priority(4)
    @allure.title("AC5: Validate Community Interaction After Posting Message")
    @allure.description("Add a discussion post via API and verify it appears in the Group Interaction table using 'Today's Count' to bypass pagination limits")
    def test_04_validate_post_message_community_interaction(self):
    
        self.coach_page.reload()
        self.coach_page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        initial_today_count = self.group_interaction_page.get_today_interaction_count()
    
        # Step 3: Post a message via API
        subject = f"Test Post - {self.test_timestamp}"
        description = "Automated test: Validating community interaction tracking for post"
        response = self.group_interaction_page.post_message(
            auth_token=self.user_auth_token,
            subject=subject,
            description=description,
            cohort=self.api_cohort_name
        )
    
        # Store message ID for potential follow-up tests
        self.__class__.message_id = response.get("id")
        self.__class__.user_id = response.get("user", {}).get("id")
        assert self.message_id is not None, "Message ID should not be None"
    
        # Step 4: Refresh the page and wait for updates
        self.coach_page.reload()
        self.coach_page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        updated_today_count = self.group_interaction_page.get_today_interaction_count()
    
>       assert updated_today_count > initial_today_count, \
            f"Today's interaction count should increase (Before: {initial_today_count}, After: {updated_today_count})"
